days.title: Ancient Trees and Peaks of Balderschwang
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Balderschwang
stops.detail: The people of Balderschwang call their home "Bavarian Siberia".

stops.name: old yew tree in Balderschwang
stops.detail: The old yew tree in Balderschwang is said to have been standing here for up to 2,000 years.

stops.name: path of the old trees
stops.detail: There you will find the path of the old trees, where one veteran tree follows the next.

stops.name: Siplinger Kopf
stops.detail: A popular Nagelfluh peak and also the highest point is the Siplinger Kopf.

days.title: High Passes and Winter Valleys
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Riedberg
stops.detail: The Riedberg is Germany's highest road pass.

stops.name: Riedberger Horn
stops.detail: North of the pass rises the Riedberger Horn, which, with snow guaranteed until spring, is popular among alpine skiers and ski tourers.

stops.name: Weißachtal
stops.detail: In the forest of the Weißachtal hundreds of birds make the forest come alive with their songs.

stops.name: Ostertaltobeln
stops.detail: Indeed, this is also evident in the Ostertaltobeln, which can only be visited in winter in the company of the rangers.

stops.name: AlpSeeHaus
stops.detail: We end our tour where all the water comes together, near Immenstadt at the Nagelfluhkette Nature Park Centre, also known as the "AlpSeeHaus".

stops.name: Big Alpsee
stops.detail: It is beautifully situated on the Big Alpsee, the largest natural lake in the Allgäu.

stops.name: Gunzesrieder Valley
stops.detail: The Gunzesrieder Valley lies in the middle of the nature park.
